data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error (HTTP 400 API failure) in the Qwen model when attempting to audit .SRCINFO, which forced an 'inconclusive' overall verdict. The DeepSeek model successfully audited all files, including .SRCINFO, and correctly found them safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should implement retries or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors (like HTTP 400) instead of failing the file audit and forcing an inconclusive package verdict.

Since .SRCINFO is an auto-generated metadata file containing no executable code, a failure to audit it should not override a safe verdict on the PKGBUILD, provided the PKGBUILD itself was fully and safely audited.
